summary: Rename the unreleased do-notation helper bindMap to the reserved word let across Functor and 20 data-type modules.
test_command: npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && { rm -f node_modules/.bench-result.json; npx jest --coverage=false test/bench- test/Option test/Task.ts test/Functor --json --outputFile=node_modules/.bench-result.json; rc=$?; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const [rc,...h]=process.argv.slice(1);const on=h.some(p=>fs.existsSync(p));let r=null;try{r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/.bench-result.json','utf8'))}catch(e){}if(!r){if(rc==='0'){console.log('[setup failed] hidden tests did not run (no test report)');process.exit(1)}process.exit(+rc)}const t=r.testResults||[];const as=x=>x.assertionResults||[];const f=t.filter(x=>x.status==='failed'&&!as(x).some(a=>a.status==='failed'));if(f.length)console.log('[setup failed] '+f.length+' test file(s) failed to load');else if(r.numFailedTests>0)console.log('--- FAIL: '+r.numFailedTests+' test(s) failed');if(rc==='0'&&on&&!t.some(x=>/bench[-_]/.test(x.name.replace(/.*[\x5c/]/,''))&&as(x).some(a=>a.status==='passed')&&!as(x).some(a=>a.status==='failed'))){console.log('[setup failed] hidden tests did not run');process.exit(1)}process.exit(+rc)" "$rc" test/bench-let.ts; }

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream rename commit; that commit is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.dependency_cache: test_command runs `npm ci` against the committed package-lock.json on every invocation. The time budget (< 2 minutes per run) assumes a warm npm cache (~/.npm/_cacache) holding this lockfile's packages, e.g. pre-seeded by one verifier run or a cache image; the first cold run downloads from the npm registry. Agents need no network for tests once the cache is warm.
provenance.test_runner: jest 26 + ts-jest (type-checked) from jest.config.js with --coverage=false (the config enforces 100 % coverage, which fails any partial run); runs the hidden tests plus test/Option, test/Task.ts and test/Functor. test/Either is not run: its parseJSON case pins a V8 error message that changed in newer Node releases. The hidden spec reaches the modules through loosely typed handles so it compiles at base and fails on behaviour (assert mode). npm ci fetches the dtslint devDependency from GitHub (a git dependency in the lockfile). Hidden-test guard: when the hidden test files are present, a run that exits 0 must show that they ran (jest/vitest: the JSON report has a bench_/bench- test file with at least one passed and no failed assertion; mocha/node:test: the captured output contains a `bench:` suite title); otherwise the command prints `[setup failed] hidden tests did not run` and exits 1.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
